body:
This massive creature looks like an elephant with the head of a giant owl. Beneath its tusks, two clawed arms protrude from its body, one to each side of its elephantine trunk. Its feathered owl head is dark brown, fading to gray as it blends into its elephant–like body.

Owlephant
CR 8

XP 4,800
N Huge magical beast
Init –1; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +18

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 7, flat-footed 16 (–1 Dex, +9 natural, –2 size)
hp 95 (10d10+40)
Fort +13; Ref +6; Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 25 ft.
Melee slam +10 (2d6+2), 2 talons +10 (1d8+2), gore +10 (2d8+3)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks trample (2d8+3, DC 17)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 9, Con 19, Int 5, Wis 12, Cha 10
Base Atk +10; CMB +14; CMD 23 (27 vs. trip)
Feats Endurance, Great Fortitude, Improved Bull Rush, Iron Will, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception) B, Weapon FinesseB
Skills Perception +18, Stealth +1; Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth

ECOLOGY

Environment warm forests
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

An owlephant attacks by raking with its claws and goring with its tusks.
